MoonPay is a fiat-to-crypto payment service provider. MoonPay is operated by a centralized company that intermediates purchases of cryptocurrency with fiat currency.

Raydium is a decentralized exchange built on the Solana blockchain. Raydium uses an automated market maker model that relies on liquidity pools. Raydium is integrated with the OpenBook central limit order book. Raydium is non-custodial, so users trade from their own wallets.

DeFi Staking is a financial service that locks crypto assets in smart contracts on public blockchains. DeFi Staking gives participants rewards for locking their tokens. DeFi Staking is executed by smart contracts rather than by an intermediary.
